description: This file defines the AzureBlobStorageOptions class used for configuring Azure Blob Storage integration within Orleans grain storage. It contains properties for connection details, serialization options, initialization stage, and client setup methods, along with a validator class for configuration validation.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Blob Storage, including connection setup, container name, serializer, and lifecycle stage.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureBlobStorageOptions ensuring correct configuration values.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Various overloads to configure the BlobServiceClient with connection string, URI, credentials, or a callback.
